description: Glassy design system + prayer/azkar surfaces. Creates the reusable GlassCard widget, then applies glassmorphism to the prayer-times card (and replaces its loading skeleton with blurred golden placeholders) and the azkar-library header AppBar. Does NOT touch dashboard_page.dart (the dashboard uses of GlassCard are in FEAT-003). FEAT-003 depends on this FEAT's GlassCard. Files: lib/widgets/glass_card.dart (NEW), lib/widgets/prayer_times_card.dart, lib/features/azkar/azkar_library_page.dart.
steps: Create lib/widgets/glass_card.dart: a reusable `GlassCard` StatelessWidget = ClipRRect(borderRadius) + BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur) + Container(semi-transparent fill, subtle white border, optional gradient). Params: child, borderRadius (default 20), blurSigma (default 12), color/gradient, borderColor, borderWidth, padding, margin, isDark. Use AppColors constants and `dart:ui` for ImageFilter. Keep it dependency-light (no new packages).

In lib/widgets/prayer_times_card.dart: wrap the main outer card Container (GestureDetector > Container with cardBg) with a glassy effect (GlassCard or inline ClipRRect+BackdropFilter+translucent Container) so the card reads as frosted glass with a subtle white border + blur. Change the solid cardBg to a translucent value so the blur is visible. Preserve the gold active/next-prayer chip highlight, the animated countdown ring, and the hijri/date row exactly.

In the same file's `_LoadingSkeleton`: replace the plain animated grey boxes with blurred placeholder chips — wrap each placeholder Container in ClipRRect + BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur) with an amber/gold tint for the FIRST (wider, 110) slot (the next-prayer slot) and a neutral glass tint for the rest, keeping the existing AnimationController opacity pulse. This matches the 'blurred golden cards' screenshot.

In lib/features/azkar/azkar_library_page.dart: make the AppBar glassy. Set backgroundColor: Colors.transparent and elevation: 0; add flexibleSpace: ClipRect(child: BackdropFilter(filter: ui.ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 12, sigmaY: 12), child: Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(gradient: LinearGradient(colors: [AppColors.darkGreen.withValues(alpha: 0.78), AppColors.midGreen.withValues(alpha: 0.6)]))))). Keep the existing title, foregroundColor, and the bottom: TabBar. The file already imports dart:ui as ui.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter analyze` reports 0 errors after this FEAT.
A `GlassCard` widget exists in lib/widgets/glass_card.dart and is reusable (public, parameterized).
The prayer-times card renders with a frosted-glass background and still highlights the next prayer in gold.
When loading is true, the prayer-times card shows blurred golden/glass placeholder chips (first slot gold-tinted).
The azkar-library AppBar is frosted glass and its TabBar still works.
verification: Run `flutter analyze` from e:/NiyyahTracker-mobile-app-ai and confirm 0 errors.

Build/run the app: open the dashboard (prayer card is frosted glass, next prayer gold) and open مكتبة الأذكار (glass header, tabs switch). Simulate/observe a loading state to see the blurred golden placeholders.
findings: GlassCard (lib/widgets/glass_card.dart) — stable constructor for FEAT-003 to import and use: GlassCard({super.key, required Widget child, double borderRadius = 20, double blurSigma = 12, Color? color, Gradient? gradient, Color? borderColor, double borderWidth = 1, EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding, EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin, bool isDark = false}). Defaults when caller omits: color = translucent brand-green (AppColors.paleGreen @0.50 light / AppColors.darkGreen @0.28 dark); borderColor = subtle white (0.60 light / 0.15 dark). A non-null gradient overrides color. Callers must pass a translucent color or gradient so the dart:ui backdrop blur reads through. Implemented as ClipRRect(borderRadius) -> BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX/Y=blurSigma)) -> Container(translucent fill + subtle white border + optional gradient), following dashboard's _ModernNavBar pattern. Prayer-times card: outer shadow Container wraps GlassCard(borderRadius:24, color = translucent 0xFF111B14@0.55 dark / white@0.55 light); gold active/next-prayer chip, countdown ring, hijri/date row preserved exactly. _LoadingSkeleton: each placeholder is ClipRRect+BackdropFilter(blur 6) + translucent Container, first (110-wide) slot gold-tinted (AppColors.gold, pulsing 0.10->0.28) with gold border, rest neutral glass (pulsing), keeping the existing AnimationController. Azkar AppBar: backgroundColor Colors.transparent, elevation 0, flexibleSpace = ClipRect+BackdropFilter(blur 12)+Container(gradient darkGreen@0.78 -> midGreen@0.60); title/foregroundColor/bottom TabBar preserved. Gate note: project-wide `flutter analyze` currently reports 237 errors, ALL pre-existing in lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_page.dart (undefined _SectionTitle/_FeatureCard/_QuickChip/_NavButton/_ModernNavBar/_QuoteCarousel/_build* etc.). That file is committed at HEAD and was never modified by FEAT-002; it is FEAT-003's job and FEAT-002 was instructed not to touch it, so project-wide 0 errors will only be reached once FEAT-003 lands the dashboard. FEAT-002's own three files analyze clean: 0 errors, 0 warnings; only 5 pre-existing info-level lints remain in prayer_times_card.dart (lines 129/291/397/493/503: unnecessary_brace_in_string_interps + unnecessary_underscores) which predate this FEAT and were left untouched to avoid refactoring unrelated code.
